notes.title: Papyrus Chronicles #2: Fruit Trees, Ibises & Demo!
notes.content:
Em hotep, Farmers!
The demo for Ancient Farmer is just around the corner - and we’ve got some exciting updates to share before you get your hands on it! This entry in the Papyrus Chronicles focuses on visual upgrades, farming expansion, and quality of life improvements that will make your time in the demo smoother and more immersive.


🏺Ancient Farm Demo launches on June 9th, 2025! 
Step into the sandals of an ambitious farmer in the heart of an ancient civilization. Start with nothing but raw land, basic tools, and a dream - and turn it into a thriving farm! With 43 guided challenges, you’ll master the essentials: from planting seasonal crops like carrots, grapes, and coffee, to raising livestock, gathering clay and wood, crafting buildings, and plowing with your trusted ox. Whether you're sowing your first wheat field or building a barn from scratch, every task helps you grow. This is your first true taste of ancient agriculture - and it's just the beginning.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3576740/Ancient_Farm_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]
🌬️ Breathing Life Into the World – Wind & Motion
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/e9d95c4df62d365228fc0b27f1ddca087b9a3b0d.gif"]

You’ll immediately notice that the world feels more alive.
Grass, crops, trees - even palm leaves - now sway gently in the wind.

It’s a small touch, but it adds a ton of atmosphere when you’re exploring or gathering clay and other materials. Ancient Egypt has never felt so alive!


🦢 Sacred Ibis – A Feathered Friend from the Nile
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/c9b91cd536c1316b85c3697c91ddf4b15a5a86ed.jpg"]

Say hello to the Sacred Ibis, a new bird you may spot near the riverbanks or flying overhead.

These majestic creatures are inspired by real Egyptian wildlife and help make the world feel richer and more authentic.


🌳 Expanded Farming – Trees & Waterside Crops
We’ve expanded the farming system to include fruit trees and wetland plants! 
🍇 Fruit Trees
Planting a fruit tree works a little differently than seasonal crops:
[olist]
Dig out a large space for planting

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/f2746e59e4bd89550a4e1520eacad5462b02bc84.jpg"]

Buy and plant a sapling from a merchant

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/eb90d9860ab52875897a43586c9549c04abd47d1.jpg"]

Care for it by watering and fertilizing at the right time

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/e4d0ca48013fdb4ae4f3427ce51fc39d3ea65cc0.jpg"]

Once grown, use a special Fruit Picker tool to harvest!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/e076287476708dcfd897e788a0a2e91925fe6862.jpg"]
[/olist]
Good news: you don’t have to replant trees after harvesting! As long as you care for them properly, they’ll continue to bear fruit in their natural yearly cycle.



Demo tree types include: Watermelon, Cotton, Wheat, Onion, Carrot, FigTree, OliveTree, CoffeeTree


💧 Wetland Plants
We’ve also added waterside crops, such as papyrus (sellable to merchants) and sugarcane (used in cooking). These plants can only be grown near water sources, and since they’re naturally irrigated, they don’t require manual watering.


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/7635ea81409e08fc52efb30dde80ff6ea3772768.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/016226558d07de3a395f1e5714d0c7a6e6e74e65.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/f1182ec2b7fd11c5f14e15430795477dc4a41f20.jpg"][/carousel]

🛠️ UI & QoL Improvements – A Smoother Experience
We’ve polished up several interface and gameplay elements to make the demo easier to play and more intuitive.
UI Layout
Detailed info windows have been moved to the bottom right corner, so you can focus on core gameplay in the center of the screen (gathering, crafting, etc.) and check stats only when needed.
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/639128e704d56a6fff05cc3a7556ba88ade07977.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/bd327fcb20ab151a9de84045a50669af3cdb60de.jpg"][/carousel]Resource Bar
A new resource bar displays your most important materials without needing to open your inventory. We’ve selected the ones we think are most useful – but if you’d like to see others included, let us know in the comments!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/a75de7aaf9bf050cade72628a96f0174e982e075.jpg"]
Notification Panel
You'll now get alerts about important events like full inventory. In the future, this panel will also notify you about health and animal care once those systems are added.


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/c553cfe9fceb493d25a2cf593d9da34037440567.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/32c5ddb2ae10ccd1994470d51e0b5e90a4928097.jpg"][/carousel]

Tool Durability Indicator
Equipped tools now show how much durability is left. When the bar runs out, the tool breaks - so keep an eye on it and craft replacements in time!


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/1dba1013f9e184966bb6c738c158a0b61f23c0b0.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/ccbcef49acec2f5720f1be5cea56ab9021fa3f1a.jpg"][/carousel]

That’s All for Now!
That wraps up this edition of the Papyrus Chronicles. We hope you’re as excited as we are for the upcoming demo and all the new features we’ve introduced.


Senebty, Farmers!
— The Dev Team

notes.title: Papyrus Chronicles #1: The Roots of Agriculture
notes.content:
Welcome, Farmers!
Today, we’re kicking off a series of dev logs that we’ll be posting regularly on our Steam page to keep you updated on the progress of our game. In this first entry, we want to introduce one of the core mechanics of Ancient Farmer—crop cultivation. Of course, we won’t be able to cover everything today, but we’ll go over the most important aspects.

As an ancient farmer, you’ll have to handle many farming-related tasks manually. The first step? Finding a suitable location to till the soil.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/054e907cef9578b4ccefdbb5e4e1de12a22de57f.jpg

To do this, you need to find a flat piece of land and clear it of any obstacles, such as stones, sticks, and other debris.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/851558b2be456441561ed15c08a0a5ff828dc059.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/cfd68e07cb2163102e749513911331b565aa87f7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/516cf2e29d7aa1967ad861129787cb40f0cfba39.jpg

Once the area is cleared, grab your hoe and start tilling! Farming isn’t just about manual labor—you’ll need the right tools to get the job done.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/48c800e53fd0776475f72d172bf5ab2cecd81d8c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/055adf708363b0da45570d966e031676cc140157.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/58a12228b510c65ad65a1147404e7492d551fc1c.jpg

We’ll dive deeper into obtaining and crafting tools in a future entry. After tilling the soil, the next step is choosing the right seeds for planting. Acquiring seeds is another crucial aspect that we’ll cover in more detail later. Keep in mind that crop growth depends on the season - some plants can only grow during specific times of the year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/7e2a6d3f84fc69d5d237a12874929c176196b54d.jpg

The Three Seasons of the Ancient Farmer
In Ancient Farmer, the year is divided into three distinct seasons:
 🌊 Akhet – The Flood Season
 🌱 Peret – The Growing Season
 🌾 Shemu – The Harvest Season
Each crop has its own seasonal preferences, so you’ll need to plan accordingly. Planting at the wrong time could lead to poor yields or crop failure. We’ll explore the in-game calendar and seasonal mechanics in an upcoming entry.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/86b0170f1f9a6a94ac7f5eec9211fb530c6c75c7.jpg

Taking Care of Your Crops
Once your crops are planted, it’s time to nurture them and ensure they grow properly. When you hover over a plant, a plant status panel will appear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/d428938a91e5e985d6852531e1904ba662f36745.jpg

This panel provides essential information, including:
 ✅ The plant’s current growth stage
 ✅ Expected yield
 ✅ Actions required to optimize growth (e.g., watering, fertilizing)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/a2dca0d2db5a271723a94351c878c6111a51e2a3.jpg

Be careful! Applying fertilizer at the wrong time can actually decrease your yield instead of boosting it. Watering your crops regularly is also essential for a healthy harvest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/c61b223a43df26a8e6dcc6dac91558b01a6a0e6f.jpg

Harvesting and Timing
Once a plant reaches full maturity, it’s time to harvest. The size of your yield depends on how well you cared for the plant and whether you fertilized it at the right times.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/e6de13e2290103f5f8e4798631c17a42e0e3a027.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/04cb80b8ef8e15eb5c34c488ed9d5944eb63e09e.jpg

However, don’t wait too long! If you fail to harvest a plant in time, it will start to rot. Initially, the yield will decrease, and after a few growth cycles, the plant will wither completely.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/8cc8519dc17a2013819686bedb30d14ffba50ba8.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43163972/90e70078006cdd1e45367a33bfa8251117fed6f8.jpg

Demo Version
In just a few weeks, we should release the demo version of the gam,e so keep your eye on the News section!

That’s All for Now!
That wraps up our first DevLog! This is just the beginning, so make sure to add the game to your wishlist and follow us on Steam to stay updated on future posts.

Em hotep, Farmers!
